comment: Definitely one of the top professors at UR. If given the opportunity, take his class, no matter the subject, because he will make it interesting and fun.

Take Neuroscience of Photography w/ Dr. Bell! He's the best - super nice and a highly understanding professor who grades fairly. The workload is manageable and mainly consists of several short essays and a final project. In class there's a combination of lecture, discussion and workshops which are super engaging and fun! Awesome professor!

Took his Neuroscience of Photography FYS. Dr. Bell's an awesome professor and loves the topics. Get ready to discuss visual neuro, photography, and vision tech (in that order). He's really nice, engaging, and makes the class pretty fun. Gives a bunch of short essays, but grades critically (B's are common). Great professor! (plus, no books to buy!)

I graduated from Richmond and Dr. Bell was the best professor I had. From day 1 he guided the class professionally. Best thing is the outside guests, We had a 70-year-old redneck that worked in China to discuss international business communication, a lawyer to discuss ethical business communication and the list could go on. Take Bell if you can
